MP4Box.js 2.4.1

License: BSD-3-Clause, reproduced in MP4Box-LICENSE.txt.

The prebuilt ESM distribution from npm mp4box@2.4.1 is vendored locally.
mp4box.all.mjs is renamed mp4box.mjs; source-map comments are removed.
The two companion ESM chunks are unchanged apart from source-map comments.
No remote scripts, eval, or runtime package installation are used.
